description: A Next.js App Router project in src/app with a pnpm 9.0 lockfile that resolves next, a configuration file, a private folder whose page is not a route, a route handler, and a .gitignore'd build directory (D-074, D-075). The manifest and both lockfiles name the real next package, so the harness creates them at test time (Q-014); the npm lockfile of another package manager is ignored.

createdAtTestTime.content:
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

settings:
  autoInstallPeers: true
  excludeLinksFromLockfile: false

importers:

  .:
    dependencies:
      next:
        specifier: ^16.2.0
        version: 16.2.1

packages:

  next@16.2.1:
    resolution: {integrity: sha512-fictional}

snapshots:

  next@16.2.1: {}
